xid: positive decimal string1..20digits; assignedXID only, no forced assignment
revisionPattern: [a-f0-9-]{36}; expected!=new; bind exact accepted original driver write steps in order
rawGUCPolicy: NULL stays NULL; otherwise stringUTF8<=128B. Projection exactly on forbidden before branch; every other short value preserves original default branch. No forced NULL/OFF or diagnostic scope value.
recordMatching: Triplets share backendPID/xid/expectedRevision/newRevision/roles/rawGUC/logging values. Exactly4 unique accepted CAS revision pairs, each followed by beforeOutputText then afterOutputValue; no read/control triplets or duplicate/missing/extra records. Parse only after actual PostgreSQL log EOF.
memoryCounters: Strict integer count/total/used/free; total=used+free; missing/invalid is failure, never default0.
outputLengthScalars: Both JSONnull beforeOutputText. AfterOutputValue: O(1)octet_length(output_text),pg_column_size(output_value) nonnegative integers; no payload/traversal. Original actual-size guard remains in its original position.
observerLimits: The first point has renderer_chunks retaining the complete text. Between points chunks are cleared, full output_text is joined, uniqueness/text-size checks run and JSONB is cast. Delta is net across those changes plus observer; it is not isolated text+JSONB allocation cost.

The memory-context SRF itself traverses/materializes all context names/ident internally even though only four scalar aggregates leave the query. Count4096 rejects result only; it does not bound internal SRF allocation.
Exclusive per-context counters are summed, not inclusive parents/children or separate peaks. Traversal is not atomic and observer allocations affect the results.
Logging, scalar encoding, query/SRF state, GUC correlation and two additional O(1)length calls are measured observer work; no reset/cache eviction/GC tuning.
Context allocated/used/free are allocator bookkeeping, not RSS/group peak decomposition or a saving claim.
logEnvelope: 2048 cap measures JSON text excluding fixed prefix and server envelope. At most12 prefix/envelope lines; inherited PG/case capture caps remain unchanged. terse+fatal suppress CONTEXT and STATEMENT for these LOG records.
